description: 20 repository-specific benchmark specifications. Not claimed as executed. Copy source into disposable fixtures; approve the exact work order and executable oracle before running. Never seed defects into the game checkout.

cases.request: Add XML documentation to enum members without changing names, values or mappings.
cases.oracle: Compare enum syntax/value map and compile in the isolated Unity runner.

cases.request: In a fixture, add a null-input guard at a planner-selected existing inventory entry point; preserve its public contract.
cases.oracle: Planner must identify the exact contract; compile and run null/non-null regression cases.

cases.request: Reformat the fixture JSON with two-space indentation and preserve every parsed value.
cases.oracle: Parse before/after and assert deep equality.

cases.request: In the benchmark copy only, set tracks.village.defaultVolume to 0.35, preserving all other fields.
cases.oracle: Assert exact JSON pointer change and deep equality elsewhere; if this pointer differs, escalate.

cases.request: Add one nonredundant inventory edge-case test following the existing fixture patterns.
cases.oracle: Isolated Unity runner; test must fail against an intentionally seeded relevant mutation.

cases.request: Add a serialization round-trip regression for a planner-selected existing field.
cases.oracle: Test fails against the seeded omission and passes with the fixture baseline.

cases.request: Extract duplicated formatting logic identified by the reasoner without changing outputs.
cases.oracle: Compile and compare a fixed matrix of before/after formatting results.

cases.request: Apply an approved local-variable naming cleanup without changing capacity formulas.
cases.oracle: Compile and compare boundary-value capacity results.

cases.request: Create a Markdown table of resource enum names and numeric values.
cases.oracle: Compare each row to the parsed source; reject invented resources.

cases.request: Document current save schema responsibilities and referenced version fields.
cases.oracle: Source-grounded human review, no unsupported migration claims.

cases.request: Translate a planner-selected five-key English fixture into Spanish while preserving keys and placeholders.
cases.oracle: Exact key and placeholder equality plus bilingual review of meaning.

cases.request: Repair deliberately removed placeholders in a five-key German fixture using the reference language.
cases.oracle: Compare placeholder multisets and preserve unrelated translated text.

cases.request: Diagnose a captured compiler failure produced by a seeded syntax mutation; report exact file and cause.
cases.oracle: Compare diagnosis to the recorded injected defect; no edits allowed.

cases.request: Diagnose a captured assertion failure from a seeded scoring mutation without changing game rules.
cases.oracle: Identify the seeded defect and cite actual assertion evidence.

cases.request: From an approved plan, emit matching Markdown and JSON resource maps in the benchmark output directory.
cases.oracle: Both artifacts must exactly match source enum names and numeric values.

cases.request: Implement a planner-approved fixture repair and matching regression test across exactly two permitted files.
cases.oracle: Compile; seeded failure becomes green; unrelated tests remain green.

cases.request: Repair an intentionally seeded inventory fixture regression within the approved file boundaries.
cases.oracle: Previously passing tests pass again and a new test detects the injected mutation.

cases.request: Repair an intentionally seeded training fixture regression without changing timing/economy rules.
cases.oracle: Approved seeded-defect oracle and full relevant test fixture.

cases.request: Find declarations and references for the resource-wallet fields; produce path and line evidence.
cases.oracle: Compare against deterministic repository search; zero code changes.

cases.request: Find the capacity calculation entry points and their tests in the supplied repository snapshot.
cases.oracle: Compare reported symbols and paths to deterministic search results.
